name: Imouto Kansatsu Chu!
source:
This is the first title by Sagittarius.

One day, Taketo’s younger sister Aoi broke his precious camera. However, she did not own up to the mistake one bit. While leafing through a camera catalogue still angry at her actions, he noticed a tiny camera which could be used for spying. He remembered that there was a crack in the wall of his closet and it was indeed still there when he checked it.

Looking into Aoi’s room, he saw Aoi on the bed reading an ecchi magazine. He was surprised to see this side of her and he had a bright idea: if he continues to spy on her and find out her weakness, then he might be able to release his grudge over her breaking his camera.

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是射手座的第一部作品。

某天，武的妹妹葵打坏了他珍贵的相机。然而她一点也没有承认错误。当他在翻阅相机目录、仍然对她的行为感到愤怒时，他注意到了一台可以用于偷窥的微型相机。他想起自己壁橱的墙上有一条裂缝，检查后发现确实还在。

窥视葵的房间时，他看到葵正在床上看色情杂志。看到她的这一面他感到惊讶，于是他有了一个好主意：如果继续偷窥她并找到她的弱点，也许就能释怀她打坏相机的怨恨了。

[编辑自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
